name: Kumaraguru Cube Open 2025

venue.name: Kumaraguru College of Technology
venue.address: Athipalayam Rd, Chinnavedampatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641049

information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website.** ​ * Kindly bring your ID card while entering the campus. ​ * All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. ​ * We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called. ​ * Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations. ​ * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. ​ * Participants must bring their own cubes.
